name: Gold hour sand
oneLine: Late-afternoon beach light: buttery bone paper, lava-black words, and the mustard gold from your overlay text as the button. This is the one colorway where the button is light with dark words on it.
fromTheGrid: Backgrounds from the sand tones (#d1ccc0, #ddddda) lifted lighter and warmed toward the mustard; text from the lava and forest-black (#1b2119) warmed with espresso (#382417); the button is the mustard of your overlay text (#d8ac4b) taken a step deeper so it stands off the page, with a darker gold edge and dark words on it; the second color is the hazy ocean (#8fa8b6) made paler, with deep ocean (#305c72) words; good is the olive (#767f63) darkened, heads up is driftwood brown (#866340) so it never looks like the brand gold, late the clay-rose (#a97d79) deepened.
trend: The reference, unchanged. Benjamin Moore's Color Trends 2027 palette happens to have the same recipe: a cozy off-white, a golden neutral, a watery pale blue, a spiced brown and a deep olive.
whatChanged: Nothing: this is Gold hour sand exactly as you saw it, here so the other five can be judged against it.

name: Honey and palm
oneLine: The same late-afternoon gold, standing under the palms: bone paper with the yellow turned down, a honey button, and a soft sage green where the sea haze was.
fromTheGrid: Backgrounds from the pale sand (#ddddda, #d1ccc0) lifted lighter with a breath of the olive (#767f63); text from the forest-black of the lava rock (#1b2119) warmed with espresso (#382417); the button is the mustard overlay text (#d8ac4b) pulled a little toward honey, with a darker edge and dark words; the second color is the palm and olive leaf (#767f63) made pale; the dark band is the deep foliage (#2f362b) warmed; good moves to a sea green from the deep ocean (#305c72) so a status never looks like the sage; heads up is driftwood (#866340), late the clay deepened.
trend: Green is the most repeated color family among the 2027 paint picks (Dulux, Behr, Sherwin-Williams and Benjamin Moore all chose a green). Dulux's is a soft sage, Soulful Sage, with a warm 'Glow' companion palette that includes honey and clay tones. Gold with sage is our pairing, not a published one.
whatChanged: The pale sea-haze blue becomes a pale palm sage, the paper loses some yellow, the dark band turns from driftwood to deep foliage, and the gold warms a touch toward honey.

name: Gold and clay
oneLine: Golden hour tipping into sunset: peach-warm sand paper, the gold button a shade deeper, and sun-warmed clay where the sea haze was. No blue anywhere.
fromTheGrid: Backgrounds from the pale sand (#d1ccc0) lifted and warmed with the peach of skin (#e1b59c); text from espresso driftwood (#382417) taken deeper; the button is the mustard overlay text (#d8ac4b) deepened toward amber so it stays louder than the clay; the second color is the clay and burnt-orange fabric in the grid (#a57c54, #e1b59c); the dark band is a red-brown driftwood (#866340) deepened; good is the olive (#767f63) darkened; heads up is driftwood; late moves to a berry from the dusty rose (#a97d79) so it never looks like the clay.
trend: Dutch Boy's 2027 Color of the Year, Deep Rooted, is an earthy orange, described by HGTV as a terracotta pot warmed by the sun at golden hour. Dutch Boy's own Essence palette sets it beside an antique white.
whatChanged: The sea-haze blue becomes a soft clay, the paper turns peachier, the gold goes one step deeper so it stays the loudest thing, and 'late' moves from clay red to berry.

name: Ochre and chocolate
oneLine: The quiet, tonal one: stone-bone paper with almost no yellow in it, chocolate-brown words, a muddier ochre button, and khaki sand as the only second color.
fromTheGrid: Backgrounds from the wet sand and stone (#d1ccc0, #bdb9b0) lifted lighter and left nearly neutral; text and the dark band from the espresso driftwood (#382417); the button is the mustard overlay text (#d8ac4b) taken browner toward the driftwood (#866340), an ochre; the second color is the wet sand itself (#d1ccc0) a step deeper, a khaki; good is the olive (#767f63) darkened; heads up is a rust from the red-brown tree bark; late the clay-rose (#a97d79) deepened.
trend: Chocolate brown is the top color in the 1stDibs designer survey, and rich gold and classic khaki are among the seven colors Wallpaper* says define 2026. Homes & Gardens calls ochre the cozy neutral following butter yellow.
whatChanged: No blue at all: the second color becomes khaki sand, the paper loses most of its yellow so the button stands alone, the gold turns a step browner (ochre), and the words and dark band become true chocolate.

name: Butter and bone
oneLine: The softest one, and the all-yellow one: a whiter bone paper, a paler butter-gold button, a butter wash for highlights, and a straw butter as the second color. No green and no blue.
fromTheGrid: Backgrounds from the pale sand and soft white (#ddddda, #f3f4f5) barely warmed; text from the lava and forest-black (#1b2119) warmed with espresso (#382417); the button is the mustard overlay text (#d8ac4b) almost as it appears on your posts, with a darker gold edge and dark words; the highlight wash is that same mustard made very pale, a butter; the second color is that mustard again, dusted with the wet sand (#d1ccc0) into a straw butter; the dark band is driftwood (#866340) deepened; good is a sea green from the deep ocean (#305c72), heads up driftwood, late the clay deepened.
trend: Pantone's New York Fashion Week Spring/Summer 2027 report has a pale butter yellow (Anise Flower) in its top ten, and a dark golden brown (Arrowwood), a warm off-white (Antique White) and a muted herbal green (Tarragon) among its five core neutrals, as reported by FashionUnited. Putting them together is our choice, and this take leaves the green out.
whatChanged: The button goes paler and sunnier (so it leans harder on its dark edge), the paper goes whiter, highlights get a butter wash, and the sea haze becomes a straw butter, so the whole page stays in one yellow family.

name: Gold and deep sea
oneLine: Gold hour sand with the ocean turned up: a cooler stone-bone paper, the same gold button, and a real dusty sea blue instead of a pale haze. Dusty, never navy.
fromTheGrid: Backgrounds from the pale stone (#f3f4f5, #ddddda) with the second background a breath of sea haze (#8fa8b6); text from the black lava rock kept warm (#0c0f0a blended with #382417); the button is the mustard overlay text (#d8ac4b) a step deeper, as in the original; the second color is the ocean in your beach posts (#638da4) softened, with deep ocean (#305c72) taken darker for the words on it; the dark band stays warm driftwood so the page never turns blue; good is the olive (#767f63) darkened, heads up driftwood (#866340), late the clay deepened.
trend: Showit studio Davey & Krista's 2026 palettes for creative businesses pair a blue slate with cinnamon wood, desert sand and a warm white ('Soft Contrast + Earthy Warmth').
whatChanged: The second color goes from a pale haze to a fuller dusty sea blue, the paper cools from butter to stone, and the highlight wash turns from butter to sea mist; the gold button is untouched.
